name: Olark
description_en:
Olark offers a website AI agent alongside human live chat. Its current AI product answers from business content,qualifies visitors using configured criteria and hands a conversation to available human agents in the same thread. Human-only live chat remains separately priced. The AI is called an AI Assistant in the application;Classic-only channels and certifications should not be assumed to apply to every current AI deployment.

An illustrative sales flow starts with a product question,collects relevant contact details,qualifies the request and either hands it to available staff or records follow-up details. A real implementation still needs maintained knowledge,staff availability and someone owning missed requests. This profile reviews public documents only;no preview submission,account,widget,AI answer,handoff,payment or export was tested.
description_zh:
Olark 同时提供网站 AI 客服与真人在线聊天。当前 AI 产品从企业内容回答、按配置标准筛选访客，并在同一对话线程中交给可用真人客服。纯真人聊天另行计价。应用将 AI 称为 AI Assistant；不能假设明确限定 Classic 的渠道或认证适用所有当前 AI 部署。

以假设销售流程为例，从产品提问开始，收集相关联系方式、筛选请求，再交给可用人员或记录跟进资料。真正实现仍需维护知识、值守可用性，并指定遗漏请求负责人。本稿仅查阅公开文档，未提交预览、未测试账号、组件、AI 回答、交接、支付或导出。

core_features.explanation_zh: 检查客服可用性，在同线程继续，无人可用时收集联系方式。

core_features.explanation_en: Choose first-response claim or rotating assignment,with per-agent chat limits for the latter.
core_features.explanation_zh: 选择首答认领或轮流分配，后者可设每客服聊天上限。

core_features.explanation_zh: 导入来源、等待 Processed 状态，使用预览／反馈并单独维护固定答案。

en: Website marketing teams needing a configured AI front line with available human follow-up.
Staffed live-chat teams that prefer human-only seats before adopting AI.

希望先用真人座席再采用 AI 的值守聊天团队。

Knowledge deletion.zh: 删除来源移除其上传知识，但明确不移除反馈／评估产生的人工训练更新；删源后应重新核对回答。

steps.zh: 选择纯真人、Standard AI 或定制方案，确认年付承诺、座席数及所需集成。

steps.zh: 安装自有账号片段／site ID，将客服设为可用，并测试路由及全部满载行为。

steps.zh: 载入已批准公开知识，等待处理，评估错答／陈旧答案，仅发布并部署已核对的助手配置。

review_notes: Vendor descriptions are documentation evidence, not independent reliability, usability or customer-outcome verification.
English and Chinese are paired drafts. Chinese text does not establish Chinese UI support.
All alternative relationships remain unreviewed. Public-web retrieval may use cached content; prices are dated observations.

sections.title_en: Understand the current AI product and Classic boundary
sections.title_zh: 理解当前 AI 产品与 Classic 边界
sections.en:
Olark now leads with an AI Website Agent for website questions,lead qualification and timely engagement. In the app,the agent is called an AI Assistant. Human live chat is the other side of the same conversation,and a human-only subscription remains available. Current features describe same-thread handoff after checking availability,and contact capture when nobody is available. These are vendor-documented capabilities,not measured response or sales outcomes.

The feature page explicitly labels WhatsApp,SMS,chat ratings and its cited WCAG2.1AA chatbox certification as Olark Classic. AI Analyst is beta. Older help pages also warn they are being updated. An implementation should identify the deployed console,widget and assistant version before importing old channel,accessibility or ratings assumptions into a new AI purchase. Neither a free website preview nor the old free-plan help page proves a permanently free current AI service.
sections.zh:
Olark 当前主要销售面向网站问答、线索筛选及适时互动的 AI Website Agent，应用内称 AI Assistant。真人聊天处于同一会话另一侧，也仍可单独订阅纯真人版。当前功能描述检查可用性后的同线程交接，以及无人可用时收集联系方式。这些是厂商文档能力，不是测得的回应或销售效果。

功能页明确将 WhatsApp、SMS、聊天评分及所引 WCAG2.1AA 聊天框认证标为 Olark Classic，AI Analyst 为 beta。旧帮助页也警示正在更新。实现前需确定实际控制台、组件及助手版本，不能把旧渠道、无障碍或评分假设直接带入新 AI 采购。免费网站预览或旧免费套餐帮助页都不证明当前 AI 可永久免费。

sections.title_en: Follow a prospect from a question to a responsible human
sections.title_zh: 将潜客从提问交到负责人
sections.en:
Consider an illustrative equipment inquiry. The current feature page describes own-domain live website search,uploaded documents and indexed snapshots,with live site content preferred when it conflicts with files for site-related questions. Plain-language criteria can qualify the visitor,and validated in-chat fields can gather contact details. Proactive engagement is opt-in per assistant and may use pages,time,scroll depth,return visits or campaign parameters. These signals are context,not verified identity or purchase authority.

When the visitor asks for a person or the question is outside the agent’s knowledge,Olark describes checking human availability and handing off inside the same thread. If nobody is available,it gathers follow-up details. Test an invalid email,wrong qualification,missing knowledge and a fully busy team. Decide who owns that offline follow-up and how it reaches the CRM;contact capture itself does not complete a sale or resolve support. Claims of immediate fresh knowledge or prompt-injection resistance were not independently tested.
sections.zh:
以假设设备咨询为例，当前功能页描述自有域实时网站搜索、上传文档及索引快照，并在网站相关问题存在文件冲突时优先实时网站内容。自然语言标准可筛选访客，通过已校验的聊天内字段采集联系资料。主动互动按助手选择启用，可参考页面、时间、滚动、回访或活动参数；这些是上下文，不是已证身份或购买权限。

访客要真人或问题超出知识时，Olark 描述检查真人可用性并在同线程交接。无人可用则采集跟进资料。需测试无效邮箱、筛选错误、知识缺失及全员忙碌，并决定谁负责离线跟进、如何进入 CRM。采集联系人本身不完成销售或解决支持。即时新鲜知识及抗提示注入主张未独立测试。

sections.title_en: Removing a source is not a full knowledge reset
sections.title_zh: 移除来源不等于重置全部知识
sections.en:
The help guide imports public URLs or files and asks administrators to wait for Processed status. A crawl option can add other website pages. Representative limits are PDF5MB,DOCX1MB,plain text/Markdown/CSV100KB,and audio20MB. The same page lists JPG/JPEG support while saying images are skipped in file ingestion;do not assume image extraction works from a supported extension. Keep sensitive material out of customer-answer sources.

Deleting a source removes uploaded information but explicitly retains manual training updates from feedback/evaluation. Stock Answers separately map example questions to preferred wording;persona and offline-only behavior are additional configuration. In the latter mode,any human agent logged in and available disables the bot. To retire an old policy,check the source,stock answers,manual feedback and actual assistant configuration together.

The current feature page adds a draft/test/publish flow and distinguishes publishing from deploying. Its live-site preference and the older stock-answer instructions have not been reconciled through an account test. Test a removed return policy,a conflicting PDF and a manually corrected answer in the actual deployment. Do not equate a processed upload,positive feedback or a published draft with complete runtime activation.
sections.zh:
帮助指南可导入公开 URL 或文件，要求等待 Processed 状态，爬取选项可增加网站其他页面。示例限制为 PDF5MB、DOCX1MB、纯文本／Markdown／CSV100KB、音频20MB。同页列 JPG／JPEG 支持，又称文件导入跳过图片，不能凭扩展名认为图像提取可用。客户回答来源应排除敏感资料。

删除来源移除上传资料，但明确保留反馈／评估的人工训练更新。Stock Answers 另外将示例问题映射到优先措辞，persona 与仅离线运行又是独立配置。后者在任何真人登录且设可用时禁用机器人。停用旧政策时应一起检查来源、固定答案、人工反馈及真实助手配置。

当前功能页增加草稿／测试／发布流程，并区分发布与部署。实时网站优先与较旧固定答案说明尚未通过账户测试协调。需在实际部署中测试移除的退货政策、冲突 PDF 及人工改过的答案。上传处理完、正向反馈或草稿发布都不等于运行时已完整启用。

sections.title_en: Choose who claims the chat and what happens at capacity
sections.title_zh: 明确谁认领聊天及满载后行为
sections.en:
New Olark routing offers two paths. By default,all available agents see an incoming request and the first to reply claims it. Alternatively,next-in-line routing sends each new chat to one available agent,attempting to distribute by least-recently-assigned order. The order resets after all agents log off;it is not a skill or equal-workload guarantee. New chats may also default to a chosen group.

Per-agent concurrent limits apply with next-in-line routing. An agent at the limit receives no new chats until one ends,and when all online agents are full,the visitor sees the offline chatbox until capacity returns. This differs from a guaranteed visible live queue. Test the AI offline-only switch when humans are online but full:the AI guide says available humans disable that mode,but the combined status interaction was not executed here. Configure an accountable fallback rather than promising24/7 human response from a24/7 AI headline.
sections.zh:
新版 Olark 有两种路由。默认所有可用客服看到请求，先回复者认领；另一种 next-in-line 每次交给一位可用客服，尝试按最久未分配顺序轮流。全员退出后顺序重置，不保证技能或工作量相等。新聊天也可默认分配指定组。

每客服并发限制配合 next-in-line 使用。满载客服在已有聊天结束前不收新聊天；所有在线客服满载时，访客看到离线聊天框，直到恢复容量。这不同于保证可见的实时队列。需测试真人在线但满载时 AI 的仅离线开关：指南称可用真人会禁用该模式，但此次未执行组合状态测试。应配置负责回退的人，不能从24小时 AI 标题承诺24小时真人回应。

sections.title_en: Count the human seats even when AI pricing is flat
sections.title_zh: AI 固定价仍需计算真人座席
sections.en:
Standard AI Website Agent is400/month billed annually,4,800/year,and includes one human agent seat. The current page advertises unlimited AI conversations with no token limits or overage charges. Additional human seats are29/agent/month;its two- and three-seat examples are429 and458 monthly equivalents. Human-only live chat is29/agent/month. Custom packages cover regional routing,multiple teams,advanced integrations,SSO and contractual service levels. Currency code,taxes and extra-seat commitment were not established,so this profile does not normalize a universal price.

The role guide counts Account Owner,Admin and Agent as seats because all can chat,and offers no monitoring-only seat type. Agents can access transcripts,while administration,billing,integrations and enabling AI are elevated privileges. A manager login may therefore add cost without creating per-agent transcript privacy. The14-day no-card trial is explicit for human live chat;the free public-site preview is a different evaluation surface.
sections.zh:
Standard AI Website Agent 每月400、年付4,800，含1真人座席。当前页面宣传 AI 对话无限，无 token 上限或超额费。额外真人每座席每月29，2及3座席示例折合月价429及458。纯真人聊天每座席每月29。定制方案覆盖区域路由、多团队、高级集成、SSO 及合同服务等级。币种代码、税费及额外座席承诺未建立，因此不归一为通用价格。

角色指南因所有人都能聊天，将 Account Owner、Admin 及 Agent 均算座席，并无仅监控座席类型。客服可访问聊天记录，管理、计费、集成及启用 AI 属较高权限。因此经理账号可能增加成本，也不会自然形成按客服隔离的聊天隐私。真人聊天明确提供14天无卡试用，公开网站免费预览则是另一评估入口。

sections.title_en: Validate record access,exit and AI responsibilities
sections.title_zh: 核对记录访问、退出及 AI 责任
sections.en:
Paid plans expose searchable transcripts,with visitor context,tags,notes and conversation history. The transcript guide allows account members to use a current-transcript link. Admins can delete transcripts irreversibly and exclude a conversation from aggregate ratings. These capabilities affect both access control and interpretation of performance metrics. Transcript Reports are CSV exports of associated information;the role guide explicitly calls them metadata exports. Full message,attachment and restoration portability was not established.

The February2025 terms grant a proprietary limited service license. They say AI answers can be inaccurate or hallucinated and require appropriate evaluation,human review and disclosure. Their training wording has service-performance,fraud/abuse and feedback/usage-log exceptions;it is not an unconditional no-data-use promise. Read the actual DPA and provider flow before sensitive use.

Normal subscription cancellation must use dashboard billing and takes effect at the end of the paid period;an email/chat request is not cancellation. Partial unused-period refunds are generally not owed,with specified breach or prolonged-suspension exceptions. Vendor termination is a different path and can remove access/content. Export before exit and confirm the selected contract. Olark fits a team owning knowledge and real follow-up;it is not a documented substitute for a complete ticketing system,outsourced workforce or high-stakes decision process.
sections.zh:
付费套餐提供可搜索聊天记录，含访客上下文、标签、备注及对话历史。指南允许账户成员用当前聊天记录链接。管理员能不可恢复地删记录，也能将某对话排除于汇总评分，这同时影响访问控制和绩效指标解读。Transcript Reports 是相关资料 CSV，角色指南明确称元数据导出，未建立完整消息、附件及恢复迁移能力。

2025年2月条款授专有限服务许可，称 AI 可能错误或幻觉，要求适当评估、人工复核及告知。训练措辞存在服务履行、欺诈／滥用及反馈／用量日志例外，不是无条件不使用资料承诺。敏感使用前需读实际 DPA 及提供商路径。

正常取消需走后台计费，在已付期间结束生效，邮件／聊天请求不算取消。通常不退部分未用期间费用，特定违约或长期停服有例外。厂商终止是另一路径，可能移除访问／内容。退出前应导出并确认所选合同。Olark 适合负责知识及真实跟进的团队，文档不将其建立为完整工单系统、外包人员或高影响决策流程的替代。

content_method.author: Codex (AI assistant)
content_method.method: Codex AI primary-source research, original English synthesis and corresponding Chinese translation; examples and fit judgments are editorial, not executed tests.
